The plate looks like a square-ish tray, roughly 22–25 cm across, and it is only partly in frame. I estimated each item from how much of the plate it covers and how tall it is.

- **Rice:** a mound about 10 cm wide and 3 cm high. That is roughly 150 g of cooked rice, at about 130 kcal per 100 g.
- **Steak:** three slices, each about 6 × 4 cm and 1 cm thick. Together that is about 24 cm³, so roughly 100 g, at about 190 kcal per 100 g.
- **Kale:** a pile about 9 × 8 cm and 3 cm high, but loose and airy. I put it at about 60 g, at about 90 kcal per 100 g with the dressing.
